title: Release quest-cli 0.15.1 paired with lore-cli 0.15.1 (DEC-282 (a6))
description: ONE release, 0.15.1 (opum-doc DEC-282 (a6)), carrying 0.15.0 existing scope (ODOC-556, LCLI-775; see QCLI-547, held) plus the cont1 fixes gated by (a5): items 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8. 0.15.0 stays only as the 0.15.0-rc.1 release-candidate dist-tag and is never moved to latest. QCLI-571 is outside the gate: it joins 0.15.1 only if reviewed and landed before the cut, otherwise it is the first item of the patch after (QCLI-575, retargeted to 0.15.2). The version bump, tag, promotion to main and publish each wait for the leader go; registry publication is the operator own dialog (tier 3). quest promotes first (lore version-parity reads quest main package.json).

acceptanceCriteria.text: QCLI-562, QCLI-563, QCLI-568 and the item-7 close-out (QCLI-572 AC8) are landed on dev, each through a reviewed PR
The 0.15.1 version bump and CHANGELOG cut are prepared and reported to the leader before commit (DEC-182 release path)
Promotion, tag and publish happen only on the leader go; registry publication only in the operator own dialog
